entities.name: RRC Connection Resume Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to resume a suspended RRC connection, triggered by upper layers, AS, RAN paging response, RNA updates, NR sidelink communication, or SDT initiation.

entities.name: RRCResumeRequest
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to initiate RRC connection resume.

entities.name: RRCResumeRequest1
entities.description: Alternative message transmitted by UE to initiate RRC connection resume.

entities.name: resumeCause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for RRC connection resume, with values like emergency, mps-PriorityAccess, or mcs-PriorityAccess.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Information element used in unified access control procedure, with values like '0', '2', or '8'.

entities.name: Access Identities
entities.description: Information element provided by upper layers for unified access control.

entities.name: T319
entities.description: Timer started when resume procedure is initiated for SDT.

entities.name: T319a
entities.description: Timer started when resume procedure is initiated for SDT.

entities.name: T342
entities.description: Timer stopped upon initiation of RRC connection resume procedure.

entities.name: T345
entities.description: Timer stopped upon initiation of RRC connection resume procedure.

entities.name: Access Attempt Barred
entities.description: Condition where unified access control procedure determines access is barred, causing procedure to end.

entities.name: Emergency Service Ongoing
entities.description: Condition where an emergency service is ongoing, affecting Access Category selection and resumeCause setting.

entities.name: pendingRNA-Update
entities.description: Variable set to true if access attempt is barred during RNA update, otherwise set to false.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE can trigger RNA updates and resume RRC connection.

relations.description: Procedure includes transmission of RRCResumeRequest message.
Procedure includes transmission of RRCResumeRequest1 message.
Procedure involves setting resumeCause based on trigger conditions.
Procedure involves selecting Access Category for unified access control.
Procedure uses Access Identities for unified access control.
Procedure ends if access attempt is barred.
Procedure behavior changes if emergency service is ongoing.
Procedure can be triggered when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Procedure starts timer T319 when initiated for SDT.
Procedure starts timer T319a when initiated for SDT.
Procedure stops timer T342 if running.
Procedure stops timer T345 if running.
If access attempt is barred during RNA update, pendingRNA-Update is set to true.
Procedure sets pendingRNA-Update to false upon initiation.
